messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CSA intake: control mapping and evidence handoff for LumenPay

Hi Eleni,

Thanks again for taking the time to start the CSA (CAIQ) intake with us. To keep this scoped and auditable, can you confirm the following items so we can build the LumenPay control mapping and evidence bundle?

- Confirmed scope: production LumenPay tenant (eu-west-1), integrations with Stripe and Vault. If there are any additional tenants, please note them.
- Priority controls: cryptographic key management, tenant isolation, and runtime telemetry.
- Deliverables we need from you this week: a sample of access logs (last 30 days), an export of IAM role mappings for the tenant, and any keystore custody/process docs.

I've attached an initial scope CSV and a short manifest that describes the artifacts we expect (see attachments). We'll prepare a draft CSA response (Redwood side) and share a Drive folder for artifact exchange. We can also send a DocuSign for the intake / evidence-access NDA if that helps your legal team.

Tentative next steps:
1) You confirm scope + share files to the Drive link below.
2) We schedule a 45-min evidence walk-through with our security engineer (Priyom) and control owner (Kimberly).
3) Priyom will post a consolidated keystore evidence manifest and sample log extraction guidance.

Attachments: [Attachment: initial_scope.csv (csv)], [Attachment: redwood_csa_guidance.pdf (pdf)]

Drive (placeholder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-LumenPay-CSA

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the clear checklist. We can confirm production tenant scope (eu-west-1) and the Stripe integration; Vault is currently used only for a subset of keys (payment tokens). A couple of clarifying Qs before we upload:

- For key custody: do you need HSM attestation or a high-level custody diagram and key usage logs?
- Logs: we can provide last 30 days of access + authz events; are there particular formats you prefer (CSV vs. JSON)?

I've attached an initial scope spreadsheet so you can see how we annotated control owners on our side. Also looping in our security team (security@lumenpay.com) for the HSM/custody answer.

Attachments: [Attachment: lumenpay_csa_scope.xlsx (xlsx)]

Best,
Eleni Papadopoulos
Senior Risk & Compliance Lead
LumenPay
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA intake: control mapping and evidence handoff for LumenPay

Thanks Eleni — that spreadsheet helps.

To answer the HSM question: for the CSA mapping we generally accept either (a) HSM attestation artifacts (vendor cert + attestation report) OR (b) a keystore custody manifest plus usage logs that show key import/export/rotation events. For regulated payment workloads we prefer (a) when available; otherwise (b) is acceptable if the manifest includes operational controls and separation-of-duties notes.

Preferred log formats: CSV for tabular authz/access events; JSON for structured telemetry. Either is fine as long as timestamps are ISO-8601 and timezone-aware.

Priyom — can you pick this up as the tech lead for keystore evidence? Priyom, we'll need: the keystore/extraction manifest template, a short example extraction script (sanitized), and the guidance we provide to external customers on redaction and PII handling.

Eleni — we created a temporary Drive folder (link below) and will send a DocuSign to cover artifact exchange if your legal team prefers that route. Once we have the artifacts, Kimberly and I will start the CSA control mapping and tag Redwood control responses to your provided evidence.

Hi all — Priyom here, taking point on keystore and runtime telemetry evidence. Quick update and what I'll deliver by EOD Friday (2027-04-16):

1) Keystore evidence package (attachments will be salted for PII):
   - keystore_evidence_manifest.md (template filled for Redwood-hosted keys)
   - example_extraction_script.sh (sanitized, shows API calls and time windows)
   - HSM attestation checklist (if you have vendor attestation we can map fields directly)

2) Telemetry/log sample guidance:
   - preferred fields: timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type, resource_id, result_code, request_id
   - sample export (CSV) with header row and 7 days of synthetic sample events.

3) Evidence packaging: we'll place artifacts in the Drive folder under /LumenPay/CSA-Evidence and set ACLs to the shared legal+security group. If you prefer DocuSign for access approval we can wait for the signed envelope before uploading sensitive docs.

Attachments: [Attachment: keystore_evidence_manifest.md (md)], [Attachment: example_extraction_script.sh (sh)]

If anyone on the LumenPay security team wants a short walkthrough, I can set aside a 30-min slot Tue/Wed next week.

—Priyom
